units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"You went through hell for us, eh? That sounds less fun than I thought... Maybe I should stick to school and be an engineer instead of a pilot. I dunno."|253|0
units.english: "You went through hell for us, eh? That sounds less fun than I thought... Maybe I should stick to school and be an engineer instead of a pilot. I dunno."
units.italian: "Ci sei passato davvero all'inferno, eh? Sembra meno divertente di quanto pensassi... Forse è meglio che continui con la scuola e diventi un ingegnere invece di un pilota. Boh."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"The Syndicate is training me to maintain and they're even going to train me to pilot their combat ships when I'm older! One day, I'll fight aliens like you did."|256|0
units.english: "The Syndicate is training me to maintain and they're even going to train me to pilot their combat ships when I'm older! One day, I'll fight aliens like you did."
units.italian: "Il Sindacato mi sta addestrando alla manutenzione, e quando sarò più grande mi addestreranno anche a pilotare le loro navi da combattimento! Un giorno combatterò gli alieni come hai fatto tu."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Honor... and service. The Syndicate will train boys like me, but I've wondered about joining the Navy. It isn't as profitable, but it sounds more noble."|259|0
units.english: "Honor... and service. The Syndicate will train boys like me, but I've wondered about joining the Navy. It isn't as profitable, but it sounds more noble."
units.italian: "Onore... e servizio. Il Sindacato addestra ragazzi come me, ma ho pensato di entrare nella Marina. Non è altrettanto redditizio, però sembra più nobile."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	You arrive at the repair shop, and an older boy, perhaps seventeen, meets the two of you. Gus stands to attention and gives you a well-practiced salute. You politely salute him in return.|261|0
units.english: You arrive at the repair shop, and an older boy, perhaps seventeen, meets the two of you. Gus stands to attention and gives you a well-practiced salute. You politely salute him in return.
units.italian: Arrivate all'officina e un ragazzo più grande, forse diciassettenne, vi viene incontro. Gus scatta sull'attenti e ti fa un saluto ben esercitato. Tu ricambi con cortesia.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	As Gus ends his salute, the boy attacks him from behind, putting him into a choke hold. It's clear he's taking extreme care when doing it. "Did you wander out of the childcare district? Was it the spaceport landing area this time? I can see scratches and bruises all over you." Gus replies, "I'm sorry, Calvin! I was curious."|262|0
units.english: As Gus ends his salute, the boy attacks him from behind, putting him into a choke hold. It's clear he's taking extreme care when doing it. "Did you wander out of the childcare district? Was it the spaceport landing area this time? I can see scratches and bruises all over you." Gus replies, "I'm sorry, Calvin! I was curious."
units.italian: Appena Gus finisce il saluto, il ragazzo lo attacca da dietro e gli fa una presa al collo. Si vede che ci sta andando con estrema attenzione. "Sei uscito dal distretto dell'infanzia? Stavolta era l'area di atterraggio dello spazioporto? Vedo graffi e lividi dappertutto." Gus risponde: "Scusa, Calvin! Ero curioso."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	Calvin lets him out of the hold and says to you, "Thank you for saving my brother. He's the only family I have left, and I hope," he pinches him, "he'll stop risking his life out of curiosity." He looks at Gus kindly. "Come on, let's get you to the medic."|263|0
units.english: Calvin lets him out of the hold and says to you, "Thank you for saving my brother. He's the only family I have left, and I hope," he pinches him, "he'll stop risking his life out of curiosity." He looks at Gus kindly. "Come on, let's get you to the medic."
units.italian: Calvin lo libera dalla presa e dice a te: "Grazie per aver salvato mio fratello. È l'unica famiglia che mi resta, e spero", gli dà un pizzicotto, "che smetta di rischiare la vita per curiosità." Guarda Gus con affetto. "Dai, andiamo dal medico."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	Calvin waves goodbye as he walks his brother in.|264|0
units.english: Calvin waves goodbye as he walks his brother in.
units.italian: Calvin ti saluta con la mano mentre accompagna dentro il fratello.
